description: Read any public web page as a clean AIDocument: Markdown plus title, description, and structure, with navigation and boilerplate stripped. Prefer this over a raw HTTP fetch whenever you need the content of a web page; it returns far cleaner, lower-token text. Powered by Lyrenth.

fresh.description: Force a fresh fetch instead of the cached version. Slower; default false.

max_tokens.description: Cap the returned content to roughly this many tokens, trimmed at a clean paragraph or sentence boundary. Use it when you have a tight context budget.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to read.

name: read_url
title: Read URL
